item.title: Dataset Update: Pre-Bunking Doctrine Deployed (45 Fact-Checks)
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has expanded its database to 45 items by initiating a "Pre-bunking" strategy. This update exposes and preemptively debunks 5 major state-sponsored disinformation tropes: the false 'command center' justification for destroying civilian infrastructure, casualty denial (the 'Pallywood' smear), delegitimization of humanitarian NGOs, attacks on international courts (ICJ/ICC), and the weaponization of antisemitism to shield state policies. All entries are backed by independent international law and human rights archives.

item.title: Dataset Update: 5 New Verifications Reaching 40 Fact-Checks
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has expanded its database to 40 verified claims. The latest additions counter state-sponsored narratives regarding the 2024 Knesset rejection of a Palestinian state, the IDF's documented use of human shields, the discriminatory 2018 Nation-State Law, engineered water deprivation, and the distortion of indigenous rights under international law. All sources are permanently archived.

item.title: Dataset Update: 5 New Verifications Added
item.description: New fact-checks regarding Scholasticide, Prisoner Abuse, Media Blackouts, Leahy Law Violations, and State-Backed Settler Violence have been added to the database.

item.title: Core Dataset Initialized: 30 Historical Fact-Checks
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has officially digitized and archived 30 foundational fact-checks countering state-sponsored PR. This core dataset covers military targeting, the Nakba, Apartheid legal consensus, media bias, and US lobbying influence. All evidence sources have been retroactively patched and permanently secured via the Wayback Machine.
